Muted blue-violet sky, restrained amber practical lights, quiet foreground. Continuous orthographic side-scrolling panorama; no game objects, UI or repeated profile tiles.

guardian.prompt: Create one isolated full-body enemy boss sprite for 6EQUJ5, a detailed 2D side-scrolling pixel-art shooter. THE FLARE BASTION, guardian of Proxima's twilight outpost. A massive low-slung six-legged siege crab machine, broad armored shell of weathered blue-grey ceramic and rusted iron, layered asymmetric solar shielding fins on its back, two heavy front crushing pincers pointing LEFT, compact glowing amber reactor within the shell and a single fierce orange sensor looking left. Heavy, believable industrial construction, exposed joints, ridged heat exchangers, battle scars. Distinct silhouette, menacing mature science fiction, not cute or humanoid. HUNTDOWN / Star Renegades high-detail pixel-art craftsmanship with deliberate crisp pixel clusters, strongest light at sensor and reactor, restrained cyan rim on dark armor. Completely side-on orthographic game sprite with slight visible front plane, facing LEFT, all feet on one horizontal baseline. Full creature entirely within image, generous transparent margin, approximately 4:3 bounding box, centered. Designed to read at256x192 runtime pixels, a large128x96world-unit boss. No scenery, floor, shadow plane, text, symbols, UI, labels, frame or decorative background. Transparent background required. Feet and claws must all be visible and clear of edges.
guardian.export: Trim to alpha>=64 body bounds, fit within248x184 without distortion, bottom-center in256x192RGBA; faint source residue excluded from floor anchor.
